reason: Restructures core Liquid DI wiring so filters like resource_url/sanitize_html/supported_cultures now only register when specific features (Resources/Html/Localization) are enabled instead of always via AddLiquidViews, which could silently break liquid templates across many existing sites/themes depending on feature enablement state.
